lemma dvd_n_implies_dvd_factorial {n d : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hd : d ∣ n) : d ∣ n.factorial := by cases n with
| zero => contradiction
| succ n =>
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ n]
  exact dvd_trans hd (Nat.dvd_mul_right (n + 1) n.factorial)

/-- Helper: (n+1) * (n! + 1) = (n+1)! + (n+1) - 1. -/

lemma mul_fact_plus_one_identity (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1) * (n.factorial + 1) = (n + 1).factorial + n + 1 := by aesop
